tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Search for available private guided tours in Amsterdam and the Netherlands. Returns tour names, prices, slugs and descriptions, shown as tour cards where the client supports it.

tools.name: get_tour_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific tour including full description, pricing and booking URL.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a tour booking inquiry. Returns confirmation when the inquiry is received. A member of the Amsterdam Experiences team replies by email to confirm availability.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tour_details · Private data: search_tours · Public sink: submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tour_details · Private data: search_tours · Public sink: submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
